title: Nifty Crunchy Thai Chicken Noodles
description: A funky, crunchy crowd-pleaser that blends mellow tomato, garlic, and ginger with a protein-packed protein punch and a bit of sweet with the crunch of shredded cabbage and bell pepper together with the chewy noodles you love.
instructions: Heat vegetable oil in the pressure cooker over medium heat.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger and sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Toss in diced chicken thighs and sear until lightly browned, about 3 minutes.
Pour in chicken broth, crush bouillon cubes into the liquid, and stir.
Add soy sauce, brown sugar, and lime juice; stir until sugar dissolves.
Seal the pressure cooker lid and cook on high pressure for 5 minutes.
Quick release the pressure and open the lid, then stir in shredded cabbage and sliced bell pepper.
Break apart the kanom jeen noodles in a bowl and add them to the cooker, then simmer for 2 minutes until noodles are heated through.
Transfer the noodle mixture to a serving dish and sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and chopped cilantro.
Serve hot, optionally with extra lime wedges on the side.
